user.title: SpinJam
user.description: Select the media players SpinJam should watch. Put higher-priority sources first. When a Sonos/Port source is Line-in, SpinJam uses the vinyl player instead. Optionally pick one or more Google Cast or Samsung TV displays.

init.title: SpinJam options
init.description: Update sources, displays, lyric timing, and display options. Defaults: dashboard_path=spinjam-tv, view_path=now. Displays may be Google Cast or Samsung TV media players. Call spinjam.create_dashboard once or create the dashboard manually (see docs/TV_CAST.md). Fallback lyrics providers run in list order after LRCLIB. QQ Music is an unofficial endpoint, for personal use.

data.name: Name
data.displays: Display media players (Cast or Samsung TV, optional)
data.scale_lyrics: Scale lyric timestamps when the edit length is slightly off
data.builtin_casting: Built-in display launch (Cast, or the SpinJam Tizen app on a Samsung TV)
data.dashboard_path: Cast dashboard path (must include a hyphen)
data.recast_on_startup: Re-cast on Home Assistant restart if Cast was on
data.power_off_display_on_stop: Power off display when stopping (default off; Cast quit leaves TV on)
data.hd_artwork: High-resolution album art (iTunes / Cover Art Archive)
data.prefetch: Prefetch next-track art and lyrics when the queue exposes them
data.frame_art_mode: Frame Art Mode when lyrics are off

data_description.fallback_providers: Tried in order after LRCLIB misses. QQ Music is an unofficial endpoint, for personal use. lyrics.ovh returns unsynced text.
data_description.lyric_offset_ms: Higher = lyrics appear later. Lower/negative = lyrics appear earlier.
data_description.sync_offset_ms: Added to the playhead. Lyric delay is separate: higher means lyrics appear later.
data_description.lyric_nudge_ms: How far the Lyrics earlier and Lyrics later buttons move the delay.
data_description.scale_lyrics: Off by default. When on, synced timestamps stretch to the player length if the edit is off by 3–30 seconds.
data_description.tizen_app_id: Installed app id from your TV certificate, such as AbCdEfGhIj.Display. Required to launch the SpinJam app. Leave blank if you only use Cast.
data_description.frame_art_mode: Off by default. On a Samsung Frame, upload the current cover to Art Mode while lyrics are off. Needs samsungtvws or samsungframetv, and the token already stored by the Samsung TV integration.

start.name: Start SpinJam display
start.description: Start source tracking and a SpinJam display session. Cast devices get the Lovelace view; Samsung TVs launch the SpinJam Tizen app. Same as turning on switch.spinjam_cast.

display.name: Display
display.description: Optional configured media_player to cast to.

stop.name: Stop SpinJam display
stop.description: Stop source tracking, end the SpinJam display session, and fire spinjam_stop. Same as turning off switch.spinjam_cast.

create_dashboard.name: Create SpinJam dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Create the Lovelace dashboard or upgrade it in place: add Cast, Display, Source, and Lyrics tiles and remove the retired tracking tile without duplicating cards or editing cards you added.

dashboard_path.name: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Lovelace url_path (must include a hyphen). Defaults to options / spinjam-tv.

view_path.name: View path
view_path.description: View path inside the dashboard. Defaults to now.

lyric_offset.name: Lyric delay
lyric_offset.description: Higher = lyrics appear later. Lower/negative = lyrics appear earlier.
